**Refined: C4 chunk migration INCOMPLETE — brain-audit/brain-check/release still read via readChunkObservations**

**What (refined by C3 exploration 2026-07-12):** `memory:share` still materializes `.memory/chunks/*.jsonl.gz` post-C4 (`engram.mjs:320-322` `_defaultShareExport` → `dualWriteRecords`). NOT merely orphaned junk — they are **load-bearing**: C4's (#229) migration to the records format was INCOMPLETE. Only `run-check.mjs` (pre-merge `memory-gate`, governance.yml:174) migrated to `readRecordObservations`. **`brain-audit.mjs` (post-merge, governance-postmerge.yml:42) + `brain-check.mjs` + `release.yml:43` STILL read exclusively via `readChunkObservations` (`lib/chunk-reader.mjs`)** — never migrated.

**Why it matters:** removing chunk materialization without first migrating those two consumers would silently break `memoryPresence` there. So the durability/records story is 1-of-3-consumers-done, not done.

**Disposition:** OUT of C3 scope (C3 = plainfiles backend). File as its OWN follow-up issue: "complete the C4 chunk→records migration for brain-audit/brain-check/release, then retire chunk materialization." Supersedes the earlier vaguer .gitignore-vs-suppress framing. Related: [[plan-adapters-v3/next-slice]], [[sdd/issue-244-a4/resume]].
